name: p3n-office-addin
description: p3n for Word and Excel: check selected text for AI and rewrite it so it doesn't read as AI, in a task pane.

scripts.start: office-addin-debugging start manifest.dev.xml desktop --app word --no-debug --dev-server "node dev/server.mjs" --dev-server-port 3000
scripts.start:excel: office-addin-debugging start manifest.dev.xml desktop --app excel --no-debug --dev-server "node dev/server.mjs" --dev-server-port 3000
scripts.validate: office-addin-manifest validate manifest.xml && office-addin-manifest validate manifest.dev.xml
